001package com.streamConverter.test;
002
003import java.io.File;
004import java.io.IOException;
005import java.nio.file.Files;
006import java.nio.file.Path;
007import java.nio.file.Paths;
008import java.util.ArrayList;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.stream.Stream;
011import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilder;
012import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;
013import org.w3c.dom.Document;
014import org.w3c.dom.Element;
015import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;
016
017/**
018 * Utility class to analyze test failures from XML test reports
019 *
020 * <p>This class parses JUnit XML test reports and extracts detailed failure information for easier
021 * debugging and analysis.
022 */
023public class TestFailureAnalyzer {
024
025  /** Private constructor to prevent instantiation of utility class */
026  private TestFailureAnalyzer() {
027    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Utility class should not be instantiated");
028  }
029
030  /** Represents a single test failure with detailed information */
031  public static class TestFailure {
032    private final String testClass;
033    private final String testMethod;
034    private final String failureType;
035    private final String failureMessage;
036    private final String stackTrace;
037    private final double executionTime;
038
039    /**
040     * Creates a new TestFailure instance with the provided details
041     *
042     * @param testClass the fully qualified name of the test class
043     * @param testMethod the name of the failed test method
044     * @param failureType the type of failure (e.g., AssertionError, NullPointerException)
045     * @param failureMessage the failure message
046     * @param stackTrace the complete stack trace of the failure
047     * @param executionTime the time in seconds the test took to execute
048     */
049    public TestFailure(
050        String testClass,
051        String testMethod,
052        String failureType,
053        String failureMessage,
054        String stackTrace,
055        double executionTime) {
056      this.testClass = testClass;
057      this.testMethod = testMethod;
058      this.failureType = failureType;
059      this.failureMessage = failureMessage;
060      this.stackTrace = stackTrace;
061      this.executionTime = executionTime;
062    }
063
064    /**
065     * Gets the fully qualified name of the test class
066     *
067     * @return the fully qualified name of the test class
068     */
069    public String getTestClass() {
070      return testClass;
071    }
072
073    /**
074     * Gets the name of the failed test method
075     *
076     * @return the name of the failed test method
077     */
078    public String getTestMethod() {
079      return testMethod;
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * Gets the type of failure
084     *
085     * @return the type of failure (e.g., AssertionError, NullPointerException)
086     */
087    public String getFailureType() {
088      return failureType;
089    }
090
091    /**
092     * Gets the failure message
093     *
094     * @return the failure message
095     */
096    public String getFailureMessage() {
097      return failureMessage;
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * Gets the complete stack trace of the failure
102     *
103     * @return the complete stack trace of the failure
104     */
105    public String getStackTrace() {
106      return stackTrace;
107    }
108
109    /**
110     * Gets the execution time for the test
111     *
112     * @return the time in seconds the test took to execute
113     */
114    public double getExecutionTime() {
115      return executionTime;
116    }
117
118    @Override
119    public String toString() {
120      StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
121      sb.append("=== TEST FAILURE ===\n");
122      sb.append("Class: ").append(testClass).append("\n");
123      sb.append("Method: ").append(testMethod).append("\n");
124      sb.append("Execution Time: ").append(executionTime).append("s\n");
125      sb.append("Failure Type: ").append(failureType).append("\n");
126      sb.append("Message: ").append(failureMessage).append("\n");
127      sb.append("Stack Trace:\n").append(stackTrace).append("\n");
128      sb.append("====================\n");
129      return sb.toString();
130    }
131  }
132
133  /** Represents a summary of test execution results including failure details */
134  public static class TestSummary {
135    private final int totalTests;
136    private final int failures;
137    private final int errors;
138    private final int skipped;
139    private final List<TestFailure> failureDetails;
140
141    /**
142     * Creates a new TestSummary instance
143     *
144     * @param totalTests the total number of tests executed
145     * @param failures the number of test failures
146     * @param errors the number of test errors
147     * @param skipped the number of skipped tests
148     * @param failureDetails list of detailed failure information
149     */
150    public TestSummary(
151        int totalTests, int failures, int errors, int skipped, List<TestFailure> failureDetails) {
152      this.totalTests = totalTests;
153      this.failures = failures;
154      this.errors = errors;
155      this.skipped = skipped;
156      this.failureDetails = failureDetails;
157    }
158
159    /**
160     * Gets the total number of tests executed
161     *
162     * @return the total number of tests executed
163     */
164    public int getTotalTests() {
165      return totalTests;
166    }
167
168    /**
169     * Gets the number of test failures
170     *
171     * @return the number of test failures
172     */
173    public int getFailures() {
174      return failures;
175    }
176
177    /**
178     * Gets the number of test errors
179     *
180     * @return the number of test errors
181     */
182    public int getErrors() {
183      return errors;
184    }
185
186    /**
187     * Gets the number of skipped tests
188     *
189     * @return the number of skipped tests
190     */
191    public int getSkipped() {
192      return skipped;
193    }
194
195    /**
196     * Gets the list of detailed failure information
197     *
198     * @return list of detailed failure information
199     */
200    public List<TestFailure> getFailureDetails() {
201      return failureDetails;
202    }
203
204    /**
205     * Checks if there are any failures or errors
206     *
207     * @return true if there are any failures or errors
208     */
209    public boolean hasFailures() {
210      return failures > 0 || errors > 0;
211    }
212
213    @Override
214    public String toString() {
215      StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
216      sb.append("=== TEST SUMMARY ===\n");
217      sb.append("Total Tests: ").append(totalTests).append("\n");
218      sb.append("Failures: ").append(failures).append("\n");
219      sb.append("Errors: ").append(errors).append("\n");
220      sb.append("Skipped: ").append(skipped).append("\n");
221      sb.append("Success Rate: ")
222          .append(String.format("%.1f%%", (totalTests - failures - errors) * 100.0 / totalTests))
223          .append("\n");
224      sb.append("====================\n");
225
226      if (hasFailures()) {
227        sb.append("\n");
228        for (TestFailure failure : failureDetails) {
229          sb.append(failure.toString()).append("\n");
230        }
231      }
232
233      return sb.toString();
234    }
235  }
236
237  /**
238   * Analyzes test results from XML reports in the given directory
239   *
240   * @param testResultsPath Path to test-results directory (e.g., "build/test-results/test")
241   * @return TestSummary containing failure details
242   * @throws IOException if unable to read test result files
243   */
244  public static TestSummary analyzeTestResults(String testResultsPath) throws IOException {
245    Path resultsDir = Paths.get(testResultsPath);
246
247    if (!Files.exists(resultsDir) || !Files.isDirectory(resultsDir)) {
248      throw new IOException("Test results directory not found: " + testResultsPath);
249    }
250
251    List<TestFailure> allFailures = new ArrayList<>();
252    int totalTests = 0;
253    int totalFailures = 0;
254    int totalErrors = 0;
255    int totalSkipped = 0;
256
257    try (Stream<Path> xmlFiles = Files.list(resultsDir)) {
258      for (Path xmlFile : xmlFiles.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml")).toList()) {
259        TestSummary fileSummary = parseXmlTestReport(xmlFile.toFile());
260
261        totalTests += fileSummary.getTotalTests();
262        totalFailures += fileSummary.getFailures();
263        totalErrors += fileSummary.getErrors();
264        totalSkipped += fileSummary.getSkipped();
265        allFailures.addAll(fileSummary.getFailureDetails());
266      }
267    }
268
269    return new TestSummary(totalTests, totalFailures, totalErrors, totalSkipped, allFailures);
270  }
271
272  /**
273   * Parses a single XML test report file
274   *
275   * @param xmlFile XML test report file
276   * @return TestSummary for this file
277   */
278  public static TestSummary parseXmlTestReport(File xmlFile) {
279    List<TestFailure> failures = new ArrayList<>();
280
281    try {
282      DocumentBuilderFactory factory = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();
283      DocumentBuilder builder = factory.newDocumentBuilder();
284      Document doc = builder.parse(xmlFile);
285
286      Element testsuite = doc.getDocumentElement();
287      int tests = Integer.parseInt(testsuite.getAttribute("tests"));
288      int failureCount = Integer.parseInt(testsuite.getAttribute("failures"));
289      int errorCount = Integer.parseInt(testsuite.getAttribute("errors"));
290      int skippedCount = Integer.parseInt(testsuite.getAttribute("skipped"));
291
292      NodeList testcases = testsuite.getElementsByTagName("testcase");
293
294      for (int i = 0; i < testcases.getLength(); i++) {
295        Element testcase = (Element) testcases.item(i);
296        String testClass = testcase.getAttribute("classname");
297        String testMethod = testcase.getAttribute("name");
298        double time = Double.parseDouble(testcase.getAttribute("time"));
299
300        // Check for failure
301        NodeList failureNodes = testcase.getElementsByTagName("failure");
302        if (failureNodes.getLength() > 0) {
303          Element failure = (Element) failureNodes.item(0);
304          String failureType = failure.getAttribute("type");
305          String failureMessage = failure.getAttribute("message");
306          String stackTrace = failure.getTextContent();
307
308          failures.add(
309              new TestFailure(
310                  testClass, testMethod, failureType, failureMessage, stackTrace, time));
311        }
312
313        // Check for error
314        NodeList errorNodes = testcase.getElementsByTagName("error");
315        if (errorNodes.getLength() > 0) {
316          Element error = (Element) errorNodes.item(0);
317          String errorType = error.getAttribute("type");
318          String errorMessage = error.getAttribute("message");
319          String stackTrace = error.getTextContent();
320
321          failures.add(
322              new TestFailure(testClass, testMethod, errorType, errorMessage, stackTrace, time));
323        }
324      }
325
326      return new TestSummary(tests, failureCount, errorCount, skippedCount, failures);
327
328    } catch (Exception e) {
329      System.err.println("Failed to parse XML file: " + xmlFile.getName());
330      e.printStackTrace();
331      return new TestSummary(0, 0, 0, 0, new ArrayList<>());
332    }
333  }
334
335  /**
336   * Main method for command-line usage
337   *
338   * <p>Usage: java TestFailureAnalyzer [test-results-path] If no path specified, uses
339   * "build/test-results/test"
340   *
341   * @param args command line arguments, optional test results path
342   */
343  public static void main(String[] args) {
344    String testResultsPath = args.length > 0 ? args[0] : "build/test-results/test";
345
346    try {
347      TestSummary summary = analyzeTestResults(testResultsPath);
348      System.out.println(summary);
349
350      if (summary.hasFailures()) {
351        System.exit(1); // Exit with error code if there are failures
352      }
353
354    } catch (IOException e) {
355      System.err.println("Error analyzing test results: " + e.getMessage());
356      System.exit(1);
357    }
358  }
359}
